body.statement: The globally completed active tangent arrangement has at least one full-dimensional strict chamber. The canonical search returns a chamber \(P_{v_*,b_*}^0\), rational \(u_*\), and rational Farkas certificates with \(\rho_0>0\). For \(r_0=\min\{r_{\mathrm{req}},\rho_0\}\), \(\{v:u_*\in D_v^0\}=\{v_*\}\) and \(\inf_{v\ne v_*}\inf_{g\in D_v^0}\|u_*-g\|_{\Sigma_0^{-1}}\ge r_0\). Hence \(H_{r_0}\ne\varnothing\) for \(\mathfrak G_0\) without a causal margin assumption.
body.justification: The fixed Gaussian experiment exhibits its separated point from the completed tangent geometry instead of assuming nonemptiness or evaluating an affine vector outside the simplex.
body.gap: The adjacent polyhedral and partial-identification results do not supply a scale-normalized rational distance certificate between semantic unions of local-limit cells.
body.consumer: The Job Corps encoder uses this receipt to verify the separated-domain condition for \(\mathfrak G_0\) before CertGluePFL is run.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove existence of the full-dimensional strict semantic chamber selected by the canonical program.
obligation.obstruction: Existence depends on the tangent cells covering \(\mathbb R^d\), which presently lacks the compatible-base premise. Interiority of the observed multinomial coordinates alone does not imply feasibility of the causal fiber or endpoint programs.
obligation.attempted: Once a strict chamber exists, exact rational feasibility and the violated-row calculation prove positivity of every rival distance and of \(\rho_0\). Only existence of the legal semantic chamber remains pending the proposed base-compatibility assumption.
obligation.partial_result: If the canonical search returns a strict component and point \(u_*\), then every rival component has a violated row with gap \(\gamma>0\), and Cauchy--Schwarz gives \(\|u_*-g\|_{\Sigma_0^{-1}}\ge\gamma/\|A_{i\cdot}^0\|_{\Sigma_0}\) for every \(g\) in that component. Taking the finite minimum proves the distance receipt conditional on existence of the strict semantic chamber.
